name: comp-283

frames.best_why: The banner is shown largest, with the warning icon, message, Fix it link and close cross all clear.

tagline: A slim warning strip with a Fix it link and a close cross that clears it.
summary: A dismissible warning banner. An amber triangle sits beside a short message, a link with an arrow, and an X; clicking the X removes the banner entirely.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle with a thin border and a soft drop shadow holds an amber triangle warning icon, one line of pale text, a bold Fix it link with a right arrow, and a small grey close cross at the right edge.
behaviour: Hovering the cross brightens it, hovering the link nudges its arrow forward, and clicking the cross removes the whole banner, leaving the stage empty until the demo brings it back.
demo_content: The line "Your billing address is missing." with a Fix it link.
use_when: A short warning should sit above content with a direct link to resolve it and a way to dismiss.
avoid_when: Message, link label and destination are fixed in the file, and there is only the amber warning tone.
customise: The message, link wording and where it points live in the file; onClose is the only prop, and the amber icon colour is fixed.
weight_why: One bordered bar with an icon, a link and a button.

a11y.note: The close button has a proper name and both actions focus normally, but the bar has no live-region role.

issues: The Fix it link points at an empty hash, so it leads nowhere.
polish_why: Compact and balanced, with small hover touches on the arrow and cross.
